description: Technical design document with implementation details
instruction:
Create the design document that explains HOW to implement the change.

When to include design.md (create only if any apply):
- Cross-cutting change (multiple services/modules) or new architectural pattern
- New external dependency or significant data model changes
- Security, performance, or migration complexity
- Ambiguity that benefits from technical decisions before coding

Sections:
- **Context**: Only the current state and constraints needed to explain the approach. Reference the proposal for motivation instead of restating it (e.g., "See proposal.md - Why").
- **Goals / Non-Goals**: What this design achieves and explicitly excludes. Don't restate the proposal's scope - add only design-level boundaries.
- **Decisions**: Key technical choices with rationale (why X over Y?). Include alternatives considered for each decision.
- **Risks / Trade-offs**: Known limitations, things that could go wrong. Format: [Risk] → Mitigation
- **Migration Plan**: Steps to deploy, rollback strategy (if applicable)
- **Open Questions**: Unknowns that can safely be answered later without
  changing the specs, the approach, or the task breakdown. Omit if none.

Open questions are for genuinely deferrable unknowns, not decisions you
skipped. If a question would change the specs, the chosen approach, or
the task breakdown, resolve it now - ask the user instead of guessing.

Focus on architecture and approach, not line-by-line implementation.
The proposal covers why and what; design covers how. Reference the
proposal for motivation and, once written, the specs for requirements -
if a section would only restate them, point to them instead.

Good design docs explain the "why" behind technical decisions.

产品总设计与开发规划：mendi-foundation-and-delivery-roadmap.md。
具体规格、方案和任务在对应 OpenSpec Change 中细化。
角色、授权、核心 proof、Action / Skills 与 Runs 协作遵循根目录 AGENTS.md。
当前 MVP-D02 已人工 Open，manifest 位于 .mendi/delivery-groups/20261010-02-delivery-verification-and-close/manifest.json；MVP-D01 保持 closed，历史索引保留。
归档 ID 使用 YYYY-MM-DD-NNN-change-id，NNN 按项目累计成功归档跨 Delivery 增长，与 Run 编号分开；项目入口保存 archivedChangeCount，binding 保存 archiveOrdinal。
探索材料统一保存于 Run / artifacts，不再新建 Change 级 explore.md；已有受审旧文件原样保留，有效决策收敛到正式方案。
CLI 已实现首次 delivery open、同一 open Delivery 的顺序 Change bind / 共享批次 / 累计归档、已有 focused / fast / full script 的本地前台执行与持久结果查询，以及正式 Full Test / 范围内修复 / 定向审核 / 新完整执行。status / next 优先解释显式当前进展；action start / continue / instructions / resolve、run save / submit 和 workspace diagnose 保留实际 scope 边界。save 与 diagnose 仅本地，resolve 支持 Change Apply 与显式较早阶段回退，action archive 分 execute / local-only finish，诊断不解除锁。记录命令不自动执行阶段语义工作，Author 验证不替代 Reviewer 批准或 Archive。
必要输入按操作区分；历史说明与未知 Ref 不成为查询运行依赖。人工归档后的查询不补建旧目录或调用旧 Change 活动 status。相关既有规格为 project-entry 和 delivery-workspace。
MVP-D02-A sequential-changes-and-test-entrypoints 已独立批准、由 012 实际归档并完成 change checkpoint；归档目录为 openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-10-005-sequential-changes-and-test-entrypoints，旧 Run 与 verdict 保留。
MVP-D02-B formal-full-test-and-scoped-repair 经 020 独立批准后由 021 实际归档并完成 change checkpoint；归档目录为 openspec/changes/archive/2026-10-10-006-formal-full-test-and-scoped-repair，项目累计归档数为 6。取消 unknown 与验证适用限制见 020 / 021。普通 full 命令成功不能代替正式验收，不继承 D01 Full Test。
MVP-D02-C delivery-close-and-reopen 当前活动，022 Explore 经 023 独立 Review Explore 批准，七组 proof 独立重放通过，下一步 Author Propose。方案收敛 closed 读取、Close 直接输入、新 Open / 历史结果定位及 Reopen 批次 / 新范围；旧 PASS 不覆盖新工作，unknown 不可用于 Close。Close / Reopen 尚未实现，本项目未执行收口。D02 保持 open，D03 仅为后续规划。第二个 Delivery 使用人工记录，不通过产品写命令迁移人工历史；Explore 批准不代替方案、实施或生命周期验收。
Run 布局遵循路线图 §4.1：Delivery 操作与 NNN-changes 批次同级，批次内按 Change 保存多个 Run。
正常范围内修复不因修复本身新增 Action / Run；新 Delivery 从 001 开始，Changes 批次仅在实际激活后建立，不预建批次或为其额外占号。
Storybook 归有 UI 的目标项目，接入按路线图安排，不是当前 CLI 的依赖。
